name: native-history-memory
goal: Keep verification history lookup bounded while preserving trusted ancestry and evidence checks

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Hosted macOS admission timed out at 1742 MiB available; selecting and checking trusted records materializes 46 records twice. A streamed prototype selected the same ancestor and used 1.29 GB RSS instead of 1.70 GB on the same restored history.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: test/services/trusted-base.test.ts uses four tiny records; history-fixture-integrity checks lineage only on small histories. Neither checks memory with many large valid records or inherited evidence. Extend the standard trusted-base matrix with a bounded-history workload and intact and damaged ancestry.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed test 20b331ce failed the bounded-memory assertion; focused record 1d28fc3d retains the exact command and workload evidence.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Commit 802badfc scans valid record metadata one at a time and reloads only records needed for trust and lineage, failing closed on replacement.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged test passed at 802badfc; record ff90e147 pairs with red 1515ba16 in the same environment.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
